import datetime
# Re-fetch current library and playlist library to ensure up-to-date state
song_lib=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page: break
    song_lib.extend(page)
    page_index+=1
song_lib_ids=[s['song_id'] for s in song_lib]

playlists=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=20)
    if not page: break
    playlists.extend(page)
    page_index+=1
playlist_ids=[p['playlist_id'] for p in playlists]
playlist_song_map={p['playlist_id']:p.get('song_ids',[]) for p in playlists}

unique_song_ids=set(song_lib_ids)
for sids in playlist_song_map.values():
    unique_song_ids.update(sids)

# Fetch release_date for each unique song id
song_release={}
for sid in sorted(unique_song_ids):
    info=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    song_release[sid]=info.get('release_date')

# Determine eligible <=2021 inclusive where release_date is present and parseable
eligible=set()
for sid,rd in song_release.items():
    if not rd:
        continue
    # Parse ISO datetime; handle possible Z
    iso=rd.replace('Z','+00:00')
    try:
        year=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(iso).year
    except Exception:
        continue
    if year<=2021:
        eligible.add(sid)

eligible_list=sorted(eligible)
eligible_in_song_library=sorted([sid for sid in song_lib_ids if sid in eligible])

# Per playlist removal list
playlist_remove_map={pid:sorted([sid for sid in sids if sid in eligible]) for pid,sids in playlist_song_map.items()}

print('song_lib_count',len(song_lib_ids))

print('eligible_song_ids_sample',eligible_list[:10])

print('total_playlist_removals',sum(len(sids) for sids in playlist_remove_map.values()))

cutoff_year=2021

def parse_year(rd):
    if not rd:
        return None
    try:
        iso=rd.replace('Z','+00:00')
        return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(iso).year
    except Exception:
        return None

# Verify song library: count songs with release_year<=2021
song_lib=[]

while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=token,page_index=pi,page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    song_lib.extend(page)
    pi+=1

unique_lib_ids=sorted(set([s['song_id'] for s in song_lib]))
lib_year_le=[]
for sid in unique_lib_ids:
    info=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    yr=parse_year(info.get('release_date'))
    if yr is not None and yr<=cutoff_year:
        lib_year_le.append((sid,yr,info.get('title')))

print('library_song_count',len(song_lib))

playlists=[]
pi=0
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=token,page_index=pi,page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    playlists.extend(page)
    pi+=1

playlist_song_ids=[]
for p in playlists:
    for sid in p.get('song_ids',[]):
        playlist_song_ids.append(sid)

unique_pl_song_ids=sorted(set(playlist_song_ids))
pl_year_le=[]
for sid in unique_pl_song_ids:
    info=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    yr=parse_year(info.get('release_date'))
    if yr is not None and yr<=cutoff_year:
        pl_year_le.append((sid,yr,info.get('title')))

print('playlist_count',len(playlists))
print('total_song_entries_in_playlists',len(playlist_song_ids))

# Verify none of eligible ids remain (from earlier run)

eligible_pl_set=None
